strings.en: Mia. Where is Garuda...?
Yes. To send that hated Combattler V and the Gandor Team to hell,
he appears to be upgrading his own robot...
I see. When he returns, then... tell him he's dismissed...!
What!?
He is relieved of his post. Garuda is no longer Grand General...!
Lady Oleana!? Why would you do that!?
Lord Garuda has worked so hard for planet Campbell! And yet...
Failure after failure... It is clear that remaking the Earth
is a plan beyond Garuda's abilities.
Besides... look at the monitor.
The monitor...? Th-This is! Combattler V!? How did they find this place!?
That fool Garuda was followed. The surface remains unconquered...
and he even revealed my castle's location to the enemy. Unforgivable.
Th-Then Lord Garuda...
A new commander will soon arrive from planet Campbell.
That one shall become Grand General.
(Lord Garuda driven from his post as general... If that happens...
proud Lord Garuda will surely not go on living...)
Is that understood...?
I have a request, Lady Oleana!
The Elshank's launch went off safely, too. What a relief.
After everything that happened, can we really call it safe?
Hey, Show, what are we gonna do now?
The Commander's in contact with Admiral Misumaru right now,
and depending on that, we may end up storming Jaburo again.
Jaburo's one thing, but I'm worried about Operation Stardust too.
It'll be fine. That's why the Gandor sent some of its forces to space.
Captain Bright... Londo Bell will stop the colony drop.
Hey, hey, come to think of it, what's that Nadesico ship up to now?
I hear it's been operating in space ever since it came out of the Tulip...
Then didn't we not even need to launch the Elshank?
The military and Nergal may have formed a united front,
but the Nadesico is Nergal Heavy Industries' private battleship.
It doesn't really move the way we'd like.
In an emergency like this, the military lets them do as they please?
I'd say it's precisely because it's an emergency.
Admiral Misumaru has formed a provisional HQ and leads the military,
but without Nergal Heavy Industries' help, keeping it going is hard...
and that includes us in the Gandor Team.
Nergal... What on earth are they thinking?
Admiral, what did you wish to discuss?
Yes. There's something I'd like you in the Gandor Team to do.
Are you aware that a Tulip fell in Russia the other day?
The Gandor Team has confirmed it as well.
A giant Jovian Lizard weapon emerged from that Tulip...
A giant weapon...
We've sent units several times, but every one was wiped out
by the enemy's anti-air interception system.
So Yurika, ahem... the Nadesico headed there, but...
we've lost contact with the Nadesico...
So the Nadesico got shot down by that interception system too?
Ugh, that's just it, we don't know, Hazukiii...
C-Can't you do something...?
Admiral, please pull yourself together.
I'm just so worried about Yurika, so worried...
A-Admiral...
Ahem... Sorry. You had to see me in such a sorry state...
N-Not at all.
The Nadesico has a Distortion Field,
so I don't believe it would sink so easily, but...
So the Gandor Team should go search for the Nadesico, then?
Don't take me for just a doting parent, Hazuki.
Your objective is, first and foremost, to destroy the "Nanafushi."
Nanafushi?
That's what we at HQ are calling that giant weapon.
We can't leave the threat of the Nanafushi's Railgun unchecked.
Understood. The Gandor will now head to Russia
to destroy the Nanafushi.
Yes, and while you're at it, please look after Yurika and the others, Hazuki.
Just while you're at it, of course. But do it, no matter what, Hazuki!!
Whew... Understood.
What is this place...? Mother never told me there was a place like this
in the underground factory... Wha...! Wh-What is this!?
...Garuda Unit 1... Memory circuit abnormal... Failure. Discard.
Wh... What is this? There are... rows of me...?
...Garuda Unit 2... Personality model distorted... Failure. Discard.
What is this!? Where on earth have I come!?
...Garuda Unit 3... Emotion circuit, high amplitude... Failure. Discard.
Stop it, STOP IT! Please, stop!
...Garuda Unit 4... Fusion with them attempted... Failure. Discard.
This is too cruel, Mother...! Was I... was I a robot you built too!?
Given memories and emotions, so that I fully believed
I was a Campbellian... a ridiculous mechanical puppet...
That's what I am! Grand General Garuda!
...Garuda Unit 5... Fusion successful but short-lived... Failure.
Discard the entire project.
So destroying that new weapon is our mission this time!
HQ is calling that new weapon the "Nanafushi."
Nanafushi...?
It has seven segments, so "Nanafushi."
...I can't make sense of the military's naming sense lately.
With Jaburo gone silent and everything in chaos,
they go and deploy a huge weapon like that...
The Federation tried to destroy it three times... All three wiped out...
How uneconomical...
So here comes the Nadesico! One Gravity Blast and it's over!
I see... long-range fire, huh...
What, so there's no chance for me to shine this time!?
If that's how it is, I'll study to become a cook.
Let's watch a Gekiganger disc, Akito!
Geez! Don't slack off just because you're not needed!
...Well, I guess it's the safe option.
I approve from an economic standpoint as well.
We won't have to put the Aestivalis in danger, after all.
So roundabout, Megu. What you mean is "Akito," right?
Y-Yes, that's right.
Ooh, how bold of you.
W-We'll begin the operation at once!!
I've heard the story from Commander Hazard.
You are Ilbora Saro, yes?
Yes. Then let's be brief. That device... I'd like to borrow it again.
Whether lending it to you would be meaningful for us...
that is what the Don asks.
And you already failed once, did you not? When you transferred to Earth.
This time, it won't just be me going...
The Gandor Team, whom you find as troublesome as Londo Bell...
I'll throw them somewhere they'll be easy to dispose of.
You mean... easy for you to dispose of, do you not?
Very well... so says the Don.
The Commander who used this was indeed defeated in the last war,
and no one uses it anymore. Very well, we shall lend it to you.
Thank you. ...I will surely bring the Gandor Team to ruin.
Such reassuring words, unheard for so long... The Don is most pleased.
Yes...
(Damn Hazard, why is he tied up with people like these?)
8 minutes 30 seconds until the operation begins.
Energy bypass circuit connected to the Gravity Blast.
Charge up, come out from behind the mountain, and fire the Gravity Blast!
Let's finish it with a bang!
17,000 to the planned operation point.
Phase transition engine, all systems normal.
Distortion Field output down 13%.
Final safety released.
1,500 to the planned operation point...
800 to the planned operation point...
Enemy shot fired.
Huh?
???... Did something hit us?
Distortion Field lost.
Damage extends across 18 blocks.
Phase transition engine has stopped!
Huh!?
The Nanafushi must be a gravity wave railgun...
Huh?
We've lost steering. We're going down.
Auxiliary engines, full power!
It's powerful, but generating the micro black hole
should take time, so I think we're safe for a while.
Thanks for the valuable input... But what do we do now...?
Looks like it's the Aestivalis's turn after all.
That's all. The enemy, code-named Nanafushi, is apparently a weapon
with anti-air capability pushed to the limit. In other words...
This mission will be carried out by ground units only.
So that's why they called us. Can't be helped.
Don't "can't be helped" me!
Ground units only means Lenny's Houraiou is on standby, huh?
Bernie and I are sortieing too, right?
I heard the Nadesico went ahead to take out the Nanafushi?
We've lost contact... Most likely they were hit by the enemy's railgun...
Searching for them is also part of your mission.
So we destroy the Nanafushi and find the Nadesico, right?
That's right.
Lieutenant Amada will command the operation.
Yes, sir.
The Gandor will stand by outside the Nanafushi's range.
Contact us as soon as the Nanafushi is destroyed.
